name: Minori Tomoe
source:
Sakiomi's younger sister. Their mother places them in the same room for convenience so the siblings are forced to sleep together. She calls her brother 'aniki'.

[spoiler]She appears in [url=/v20491]Sakura Hitohira Koi Moyou[/url] as tomochan, Saya's friend on SNS. They give each other advice and support in a special conversation named "Cister" which is about sisters being in love with their brothers.[/spoiler]
